in_arabic.name: إشرات
in_arabic.meaning: إشرات تعني الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و اللغة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم إشرات مشتق من الفعل أشرت و يعني الرفعة و العلو في المعنى و اللغة، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني الرفعة و الشرف في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: اشراط
in_urdu.meaning: اشراط کا مطلب ہے بلند معانی اور زبان میں رفعت
in_urdu.long_meaning: اشراط نام کی اصیل عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے بلند معانی اور زبان میں رفعت، اور یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں رفعت اور شرافت کے معنی رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: इशरात
in_hindi.meaning: इशरात का अर्थ है उच्च अर्थ और भाषा में उत्कृष्टता
in_hindi.long_meaning: इशरात नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी मूल से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है उच्च अर्थ और भाषा में उत्कृष्टता, और यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में उच्चता और शराफत के प्रतीक के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है

in_pashto.name: اشراټ
in_pashto.meaning: اشراټ معنی د لوړوالي او درناوي
in_pashto.long_meaning: اشراټ نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې د لوړوالي او درناوي ده، او دا نوم د افغان او پښتون قومونو لپاره د لوړوالي او شرافت نښه ده

in_english.name: Ishrat
in_english.meaning: Ishrat means elevation, excellence, and nobility in Arabic
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ishrat originates from the Arabic root 'sh-r-t' which signifies elevation, excellence, and nobility, reflecting a sense of grandeur and high esteem, historically used in Islamic tradition to denote someone of high moral character and spiritual significance

data.cultural_impact: The name Ishrat is a beautiful and meaningful name in Islamic culture. It is often given to a child as a sign of hope and anticipation for the blessings and mercy of Allah. The name evokes a sense of graciousness and favored status, reminding the bearer of their connection to the divine. In Arabic, 'ishrat' translates to 'gift' or 'grace,' reflecting the idea that every gift or blessing comes from Allah. This name is not only a beautiful expression of faith, but also a reminder of the generous nature of Allah and the importance of gratitude.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ishrat holds great significance in Islam. It is a reminder of the belief that all blessings come from Allah and that every person is a recipient of His grace and mercy. The name encourages the bearer to reflect on the blessings they have received and to be grateful for them. It also reminds them that every moment and experience in life is a gift from Allah, and that they should make the most of it in pursuit of spiritual growth and fulfillment. The name Ishrat is a reminder of the Divine Generosity and the human need to be grateful and steadfast in faith.
